## Defect 3 (found after filing): the build author turn is killed at 15 minutes on every mid-tier card

Measured from the recordings of the 8-card run:

| Card | Build author turn | Tool calls before the kill |
|:--|:--|:--|
| requisition_to_receipt | `no-result(exit 143)` | 61 |
| asset_lifecycle | `no-result(exit 143)` | 77 |
| leave_balances | `no-result(exit 143)` | 69 |
| order_to_cash | `no-result(exit 143)` | 91 |
| travel_expense, service_desk | no turn recorded (Defect 2) | — |

The four control-size builds finished in 17–21 turns. Exit 143 is SIGTERM from the runner's own author timeout (`ClaudeCodeDriver.author`, `authorTimeoutMs ?? 15 * 60_000`, `driver.ts`). So every 7–8-object build was cut off mid-way. That explains the Build misses: order_to_cash lacks every app navigation entry, the receivables report and all five agent actions; requisition_to_receipt lacks navigation and the dashboard. These are **not AI-quality findings until a build runs to completion**.

Correction to Defect 2: `service_desk` (the third card of its lane) also has no build author turn, so a parallel start is not the explanation. Its scaffold is at 15:24:01 and the iterate turn wrote files at 15:25. Capturing the CLI's exit code and stderr (Defect 2's ask) is what will tell.

**Ask (add to this card):**
1. Make the author and iterate timeouts a runner option (`--author-timeout`) with a default sized for the `starter` tier (#30970), e.g. 60 minutes. Record the elapsed time on every author turn.
2. A killed author turn makes the Build half **not measured: author timed out after N min**, never a degraded score. Do not run the seed, Run or iterate on it.
3. The scorecard shows the author turn's elapsed time and `resultSubtype`.

- p1, `domain:devx`, `area:devpath` and `pm:queue` kept. It blocks the measurement of every mid-tier card.
- Defect 3 is in scope for the claiming seat. If its fix differs in kind from Defects 1–2, it may split into its own card.
